guarantees.claim: tlram_gnt is asserted only when tlram_req is high and tlram_we is low; otherwise it is deasserted
tlram_rerror is constantly driven to 0, regardless of any input condition

assumptions.claim: The external requestor must ensure tlram_we is deasserted when a read request (tlram_req) is asserted, otherwise tlram_gnt will not be granted
assumptions.cond: When this module is expected to grant a read
assumptions.risk: If violated, the requestor would be stalled indefinitely (deadlock) and would not receive a grant

uncertain_points.claim: Simultaneous assertion of tlram_req and tlram_we results in tlram_gnt deasserted, potentially stalling the read request indefinitely if the write condition persists
uncertain_points.cond: When both tlram_req and tlram_we are high
uncertain_points.risk: Deadlock or livelock if external logic cannot resolve the condition

uncertain_points.claim: tlram_rerror is hardwired to 0, so any read error from underlying state memory (e.g., corruption, access violation) cannot be reported
uncertain_points.cond: Always, if an error actually occurs in the memory
uncertain_points.risk: Error masking could hide corruption of security-critical state (digest/key) leading to silent data corruption
